name: ruby-plainspoken
description: Ruby and Rails design guidance for Codex. Reads the real code first, then picks the smallest change that fits the application: no class, wrapper, comment, type alias or dependency that has nothing to do, and no loss of validation, authorization, database integrity or tests.

interface.shortDescription: Read the code, then write the smallest Ruby or Rails change that fits it
interface.longDescription: One skill for Ruby and Rails implementation, refactoring and review. It makes the agent trace the real flow and follow the application's existing pattern before it designs anything, and it rejects a new class, wrapper, comment, type alias or dependency that has no separate job. Validation, authorization, database integrity, transactions, security, accessibility, error handling and tests are never removed to make a change smaller.
